verdict.rationale: Stripe documents this use by name in "Issuing for agents": virtual cards that agents can use to make purchases autonomously, with spend controls and real-time authorization decisioning. Those cards can be scoped to a single task or session and are automatically invalidated after use. Spending controls can block merchant categories and merchant IDs and cap spend per authorization or per month, which covers merchant locks and amount caps. Missing for 10: explicit configurable time-based expiry beyond auto-invalidation after use, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent card usage.
